name: AK Turnip 1.11
description: AK Turnip 1.11: query pool resets batched into large CP_MEM_WRITE packets instead of one per field per query; ir3 prefetch sam.s2en quirk (fixes real GPU faults in Devil May Cry 5); VALVE_buffer_device_address_allocation_alignment; VK_EXT_depth_bias_control/depth_range_unrestricted; fixed sparse bind column merging and a lazy-memory GetDeviceMemoryOpaqueCaptureAddress crash; DEVICE_LOCAL-only memory type drirc option for RDR2.
author: aydar
